sections.heading: What is trending: “decreto”
paragraphs: “decreto” appeared on Google Trends' Trending Now list for ES (snapshot taken 2026-09-11T14:25:53+00:00 UTC). Google reports at least 200 searches for this term — that figure is a lower bound published in the official Trends feed, not an exact count.

sections.heading: What's behind the spike — the coverage
paragraphs: The Trends feed associates this search spike with 3 news stories from Cinco Días, Expansión, La Vanguardia. The headlines, exactly as published:
list: “SpainDC cree que el decreto para los 'data center' es un 'veto' que acabará con el sector” — Expansión
“Los centros de datos sopesan pedir indemnizaciones multimillonarias a España si se aprueba la nueva regulación” — Cinco Días
“Aragón demanda la “revisión integral” de la regulación a los centros de datos” — La Vanguardia

sections.heading: Timeline
paragraphs: The trend entry was published to the Google Trends feed at Fri, 11 Sep 2026 07:00:00 -0700. Our snapshot was taken at 2026-09-11T14:25:53+00:00 UTC and this briefing was assembled at 2026-09-11T14:26:59+00:00 UTC.

sections.heading: How to read these numbers
paragraphs: Google Trends reports approximate search volume as a lower bound (for example “20K+”). Actual volume can be significantly higher. Trending status reflects acceleration in searches, not the absolute size of a topic. For the full story behind the spike, read the cited coverage below — this briefing intentionally adds no speculation beyond the sourced facts.

faq.a: Google's Trending Now feed links the spike to coverage from Cinco Días, Expansión, La Vanguardia.
